SERVICE INSIGHT

What bench ECU remapping involves

Bench tuning uses direct connections to an ECU removed from the vehicle. Specialist equipment connects to its communication pins or connectors on a workbench to access compatible software for custom calibration.

Assess the ECU first

The correct access method depends on the ECU hardware and software. Share your registration, engine details and intended outcome; ECU removal and any specialist access requirements must be agreed before work begins.

WHAT TO EXPECT

A clear route forward.

Vehicle assessment

Compatibility and condition must be checked. Existing faults may need resolving before software work.

Agreed scope

Receive a vehicle-specific quote and discuss any supporting work before booking.

Responsible use

Check insurance, warranty and finance conditions. Road-going vehicles must retain required safety and emissions systems.

YOUR QUESTIONS

Before you decide.

What is bench ECU remapping?+

The ECU is removed from the vehicle and connected directly to specialist equipment on a workbench to read and write compatible software.

Can every ECU be bench tuned?+

The method depends on the ECU hardware, software and access requirements. Send your vehicle and ECU details for assessment.

How do I arrange this service?+

Contact us before removing or transporting an ECU. Compatibility, removal requirements, scope and pricing must be agreed first.
